reason: A DSH plugin that integrates the WeChat iLink/ClawBot private-chat channel with DSH agents, including messaging, media transfer, session persistence, memory, access controls, and scheduled prompts.

summaries.zh: 将微信 iLink/ClawBot 私聊接入 DSH agent，支持消息与媒体收发、会话记忆、访问控制及定时提示。
summaries.en: Connects WeChat iLink/ClawBot private chats to DSH agents with messaging and media exchange, session memory, access controls, and scheduled prompts.

capabilities: Connects DSH to the WeChat iLink/ClawBot service
Receives and sends text, images, audio, video, and files through private chats
Stores login credentials, user-session mappings, conversation history, prompts, and long-term memory locally
Supports scheduled prompt delivery through cron tasks
Provides access controls including private-chat policy, allowlists, send-directory boundaries, and media-size limits
